scope: complete the numerical validation, randomization, multiplicity-control, falsification-control, and decision details left qualitative in the base family-v1.2 protocol; this amendment changes no model, adapter, training run, checkpoint, validation calendar, metric definition, or practical margin

freeze_boundary.pre_existing_D0_v_validation_archives: created and frozen by family-v1.1; reused here only under the exact hashes below

required_resume_audits: file SHA256 and archive metadata match
validation day, truth, observed mask, and raw-missing mask equal the current validation bundle
atom probabilities and allocated states are exactly common for every backbone seed and sampling seed
D0-v checkpoint SHA256 equals the backbone bound by the probe run

shuffle_trained_adapter_inference_rule.properties: target-free, shared across backbone seeds and stage blocks, and exactly balanced at 25 uses per bank entry over 50 days times three sampling seeds

scenario_contract.resume_rule: reuse only an archive with a verified sidecar, complete array schema, exact metadata identity, and successful numerical/atom audit; otherwise fail closed rather than overwrite
scenario_contract.archive_retention: retain scenarios, states, atom probabilities, truth, masks, dates, runtime, and metadata for every new archive

aggregation_order: compute every metric separately for each calendar day and scenario archive
average the three sampling replicates within day and checkpoint
average the three backbone-training seeds within day
perform every formal contrast and resample on the resulting 50 paired calendar-day vectors
metric_contract.relative_daily_contribution: (reference_day_score-candidate_day_score)/mean(reference_day_score over all 50 validation days); the denominator is fixed before resampling so the mean contribution equals the registered full-validation relative improvement
metric_contract.positive_primary_contribution_means: candidate is better because all primary scores are lower-is-better

ordered_mechanism.reference: shuffle-trained adapter under the balanced training-bank inference rule

same_checkpoint_falsification.reference: mean of held-out inference orders 6 and 7 applied to each chronological checkpoint
same_checkpoint_falsification.candidate: the same chronological checkpoint under chronological inference

primary_max_T.joint_endpoints: eight DDIM blocks times two primary metrics = 16
primary_max_T.studentization: endpoint standard deviation across paired day-bootstrap mean draws; zero-SE endpoints are handled exactly
primary_max_T.critical_value: 0.95 quantile of the maximum absolute centered studentized bootstrap statistic over all 16 endpoints
primary_max_T.bands: estimate plus-or-minus critical_value times endpoint bootstrap standard error

same_checkpoint_max_T.joint_endpoints: eight DDIM blocks times two primary metrics after averaging held-out orders 6 and 7 = 16
same_checkpoint_max_T.interpretation: falsification family separate from the primary trained-control family

safety_max_T.joint_endpoints: eight blocks times level CRPS, relative joint ES, absolute coverage difference, and relative width increase versus D0-v = 32
safety_max_T.bands: two-sided simultaneous bands; upper bounds are used for one-sided deterioration gates and maximum absolute bands for coverage

stage_omnibus.null: ordered-mechanism daily benefit has the same mean in all eight DDIM blocks for both primary metrics
stage_omnibus.test: joint centered paired-day bootstrap quadratic statistic over block deviations for both metrics

NWP_regime_omnibus.null: block-averaged ordered-mechanism benefit is homogeneous across stable, moderate, and dynamic train-NWP-defined regimes for both primary metrics
NWP_regime_omnibus.test: joint target-free permutation of the frozen regime labels across complete calendar-day block vectors

block_by_NWP_interaction_omnibus.null: an additive DDIM-block plus NWP-regime model is sufficient for both primary benefit metrics
block_by_NWP_interaction_omnibus.test: joint residual-permutation test that permutes complete paired-day residual block vectors under the fitted additive null

support_and_safety_rules.primary_block_support: both primary ordered-mechanism max-T lower bands exceed zero and point estimates meet ramp >= 0.001 absolute and lagged variogram >= 0.05 relative
support_and_safety_rules.same_checkpoint_block_support: both same-checkpoint falsification max-T lower bands exceed zero
support_and_safety_rules.distribution_safety_block_support: versus D0-v, simultaneous upper deterioration bands satisfy level CRPS <= 0.0015, relative joint ES <= 0.02, absolute coverage difference <= 0.02, and relative width increase <= 0.10
support_and_safety_rules.stage_structure: at least two numerically adjacent DDIM blocks have full_block_support
support_and_safety_rules.atom_invariance: for a fixed backbone seed and sampling seed, states and zero/one probabilities must be bitwise identical across D0-v, every stage block, both trained order modes, and both held-out controls; all atom metric day vectors must consequently be bitwise identical
support_and_safety_rules.persistent_distribution_damage: at least two adjacent blocks pass primary and same-checkpoint support but no adjacent pair passes full support because one or more safety margins fail

authorization.failure_policy: write a failure record, preserve complete hashed archives, and resume only from verified archive boundaries
